title: Goofy Trapped Chests
description: Trapped chests now warn you of an incoming trap, because it's a trapped chest, obviously.
body:
**As you can see in the icon, there's a visible warning sign on every side of the trapped chest**, to warn you that it's a trapped chest.

_Please Note: This pack somehow took me a long time to make due to the very odd chest textures since it's an entity._ Don't ask me why... :|

So now, when someone tries to trap you ~~(again)~~, you can see the difference between a normal chest and a trapped chest!
